edges.description: The CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING_BBOX value (3) assigned to iter._flags at polyfill.c:759 in maxPolygonToCellsSizeExperimental propagates as the mode variable at polyfill.c:511 via FLAG_GET_CONTAINMENT_MODE(iter->_flags).
The size estimate sz returned by maxPolygonToCellsSizeExperimental propagates to the calloc allocation at fuzzerPolygonToCellsExperimental.c:60. In the vulnerable version, sz=3 is an undercount.

The write index i in polygonToCellsExperimental at polyfill.c:720 must stay below the allocated buffer size sz. In the vulnerable version, i reaches 3 (= sz) causing heap-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 8.

root_cause_criterion.description: The condition at line 511 must accept CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING_BBOX (value 3) in addition to CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING (value 2). The patch adds this disjunct so cellBoundaryCrossesPolygon fires during OVERLAPPING_BBOX size-estimation iteration, preventing undercount.
